name: Jenda Munthe
bio: Jenda Ras Yuanda Munthe (also known as Jenda McLover) is a popular Indonesian content creator, comedian, actor, and entrepreneur. Born in Jakarta in 1985, he shot to viral fame on platforms like TikTok and Instagram for his distinctive comedy style, which features him jokingly "shouting" or reacting angrily to absurd and amusing questions from netizens.

credits.title: Antara Mama, Cinta dan Surga: Bahasa Cinta Nommensen
credits.overview: Bernard, the youngest child of a Batak family, faces an inner conflict when his desire to become a priest clashes with his family's expectation of a civil servant. Haunted by the call of faith and caught between love, family, and his faith, Bernard must make life choices that will determine his future.
